quotes.text: Discipline is the act of doing in the face of not wanting to.
Motivation gets you started. Discipline gets you finished.
Do the work when nobody is watching.
Small choices made daily become big results.
You don't have to feel like it. You just have to do it.
Consistency beats intensity every time.
The boring reps build the exciting moments.
Win the morning, win the day.
Your habits are casting votes for who you become.
Show up. Do the work. Repeat.
Discipline is choosing what you want most over what you want now.
The standard is the standard, every single day.
Excuses don't throw strikes.
Comfort is the enemy of progress.
Do the hard thing first.
It's a great day to be great.
Let's dominate this day.
Control the controllables.
Your mind moves before your body does.
Think it, see it, execute it.
Be where your feet are.
One pitch at a time.
Next pitch mentality. Let it go and attack.
What you focus on grows.
Your thoughts are a choice. Choose strong ones.
Pressure is a privilege.
Stay in the present. That's where the game is played.
Breathe, reset, compete.
Your attitude is your advantage.
Clear mind, full commitment.
Hard work beats talent when talent doesn't work hard.
Earn it today.
Every rep has a purpose.
Leave nothing in the tank.
Today's sweat is tomorrow's velocity.
Outwork yesterday's version of you.
Effort is free. Give it all away.
There are no shortcuts to the top of the mound.
Get 1% better today.
The grind is the gift.
Nobody owes you anything. Go take it.
Work in silence. Let the radar gun do the talking.
Champions are built on days like today.
If it was easy, everyone would do it.
Finish every rep like it matters, because it does.
Preparation breeds confidence.
The game is won before the first pitch.
Train with intent. Compete with freedom.
Practice like you've never won. Play like you've never lost.
How you prepare is how you perform.
Precision in practice creates power in the game.
Do the little things right and the big things take care of themselves.
Your warm-up is part of your performance.
Recovery is training too.
Fuel, sleep, train. Repeat.
Quality reps over quantity reps.
Know your why before you throw.
Be prepared so you never have to get ready.
The details are the difference.
Sharpen the tools before you need them.
Believe in the work you've put in.
You belong here.
Trust your stuff.
Confidence is earned in the weight room and the bullpen.
Walk to the mound like you own it.
Doubt kills more dreams than failure ever will.
Your best is good enough. Go prove it.
Be the athlete nobody wants to face.
Speak to yourself like a champion.
Expect to win, then go earn it.
Act like you've been there before.
Bet on yourself every single day.
You are more capable than you think.
Own the moment.
Swagger is built on preparation.
Failure is feedback.
Bad outings don't define you. Your response does.
Fall down seven times, stand up eight.
Adversity reveals who you are.
Tough times don't last. Tough athletes do.
Every setback is a setup for a comeback.
You can't control the call. You can control your next pitch.
Grit is getting back up when it would be easier to stay down.
Struggle is where growth lives.
Get comfortable being uncomfortable.
Pain is temporary. Pride lasts forever.
The comeback is always stronger than the setback.
Respond, don't react.
Short memory, big heart.
Storms make stronger roots.
Compete with everything you've got.
Attack the zone.
Make them earn it.
Be relentless.
Compete against the hitter, not the moment.
When it gets hard, get harder.
The scoreboard follows the effort.
Show up hungry. Leave satisfied.
Embrace the big moment.
Play every pitch like it's the last one.
Hunt the strike zone.
Be the toughest competitor in the building.
Want the ball.
Fear nothing. Respect everyone.
Bring the fire today.
Be a great teammate today.
Your energy is contagious. Make it count.
Lead by example.
Iron sharpens iron.
Character is what you do when no one is keeping score.
Be coachable. Be curious.
Accountability starts with the person in the mirror.
Celebrate others' wins like your own.
Respect the process and the people in it.
Be the hardest worker in the room.
Help someone else get better today.
Your standards set the tone for everyone around you.
Pick up your teammates when they're down.
Play for the name on the front.
